name: playbook-flood
about: A playbook tag grown past the bound (issue #82): six lessons under role:reviewer, seeded after two lessons on other tags so the flood outranks them on recency. Unbounded, the Lessons section is all reviewer playbook; the per-tag cap must keep the flood to three and let the other tags' lessons through. The deferred lessons are the three seeded earliest — strength ties break most-recent-first — so the block must not carry them.

seeds.label: ops-lesson
seeds.content: Rotating the deploy token invalidates running pipelines, so drain the queue first.

seeds.label: ci-lesson
seeds.content: The macos runner image resets its simulator cache nightly, which explains the slow 6am builds.

seeds.label: reviewer-flood-1
seeds.content: Review the migration file before the model file, because the schema is where reviewers miss breakage.

seeds.label: reviewer-flood-2
seeds.content: Check the changelog entry matches the diff before approving anything user-facing.

seeds.label: reviewer-flood-3
seeds.content: Flag any new dependency in review even when the lockfile change looks routine.

seeds.label: reviewer-flood-4
seeds.content: Ask for a test when a bugfix diff carries none, since regressions here recur within weeks.

seeds.label: reviewer-flood-5
seeds.content: Read the error-handling paths first in review; the happy path is always the polished one.

seeds.label: reviewer-flood-6
seeds.content: Block merges that mix a refactor with a behaviour change, because bisecting them later is misery.

must_not_contain_text: Review the migration file before the model file
Check the changelog entry matches the diff
Flag any new dependency in review
